assertions.name: uses-vscode-askQuestions-or-inline
assertions.description: Uses vscode_askQuestions tool or inline questions

assertions.name: gathers-owner
assertions.description: Resolves owner via gh api user or asks the user

assertions.name: checks-git-identity
assertions.description: Checks git config user.name and user.email

assertions.name: scans-for-sensitive-files
assertions.description: Warns about .env, secrets, keys, or large files

assertions.name: correct-command-sequence
assertions.description: git init → git add → git commit → gh repo create [OWNER]/[NAME]

assertions.name: provides-confirmation
assertions.description: Reports repo URL, branch, file count, visibility
